x: Last race of the day was our first chance to see young Greg Billington in action. He had won both of his previous outings in the UK Challenge but as there had actually been three races, he was headed in the points table by Cwmbran’s Ieuan Thomas.

Those that keep an eye on the cross country results can’t fail to be impressed by the wins notched up by new Belgravian, sixteen year-old Greg Billington, a US citizen who has lived for 14 years in the UK.

Dramatic Inter-County win for Greg Billington Threatened snowfall failed to materialise and it was a friendly Wollaton Park, with sunny periods and little wind, that welcomed cross country fans for the final major fixture of the season.
